svg.title: Astra's Star Window
svg.desc: Astra's avatar with long white hair over her eyes, a white feathered angel wing and a lace tattoo, in front of a wall of purple liquid chrome · Astra's avatar winking through round glasses, white hair and freckles, against a purple starry sky · Astra's avatar in cool blue light, eyes closed, with a glowing white halo ring behind her · Astra's avatar with white hair and pale blue eyes under a full moon on a rainy night
